interface of immunology, hematology and computational biology.

## What we offer

- A translational environment with direct access to patient cohorts and
  biobanked material through the Hospices Civils de Lyon.
- Training in both wet-lab immunology and computational methods — many of our
  projects are genuinely hybrid.
- An open-science policy: code and tools are released publicly
  (see [Tools & Apps](tools/index.qmd)).

## How to apply

Send a single PDF to [contact@l2ib.fr](mailto:contact@l2ib.fr) containing:

1. A **one-page motivation letter** stating which of our
   [research axes](research.qmd) interests you and why.
2. Your **CV**, including your degree marks/rankings.
3. The **names and emails of two referees**.

Please put `[Application – M2 / PhD / Post-doc]` in the subject line. We answer
every application, usually within two weeks.

## Practical information

The team is located at the **Faculté de Médecine Lyon Sud**, Oullins-Pierre-Bénite,
~20 min from Lyon city centre (métro B + bus, or tram T1/T2 + bus).

Non-French-speaking candidates are welcome — the working language of the team is
English for science, and we help with administrative procedures, visas and
housing.
